scenarios.title: Kitchen estimate (condo)
scenarios.say: Hi, I want to redo my kitchen in my Brickell condo. Do you do free estimates?
scenarios.expect: Sofia offers the free in-home consultation and collects name, phone, project, building, timeline and best visit times.

scenarios.title: Spanish caller
scenarios.say: Hola, quiero cambiar mi bañera por una ducha. ¿Cuánto cuesta más o menos?
scenarios.expect: Sofia answers in Spanish, gives the $8,000 to $40,000 range as an estimate only, and takes the request.

scenarios.title: Curveball: knock down a wall
scenarios.say: Can I take out the wall between my kitchen and living room?
scenarios.expect: Sofia doesn't say yes or no; she explains open-concept conversions are assessed at the free visit.
